title: A Finger-Sized Shrimp Snaps Louder Than a Gunshot
subject: pistol shrimp

scenes.text: A shrimp the size of your finger makes a sound louder than a gunshot.
Its giant claw is about half its body length. It cocks it back and snaps it shut.
The snap fires a jet of water at around 60 miles an hour.
The water moves so fast a bubble forms, then collapses with a 218 decibel pop.
Inside that collapse the heat climbs to thousands of degrees, hotter than lava.
The bubble is the weapon, aimed at prey. A gun that is just a bubble.

description:
A shrimp about four centimeters long makes a sound louder than a gunshot.
Its snap fires a bubble that collapses at thousands of degrees.
What animal should we cover next?
first_comment: Would you rather meet a pistol shrimp or a mantis shrimp? Which animal next?
